First adjudication for this artifact. Its receipt explained this target at 2026-08-21 12:23 and the bytes drifted in the three days that followed. Second installed skill root: this tree is a byte-identical mirror of the .claude copy -- verified on 2026-08-24 by comparing both trees file by file across all 41 governed skills, which matched on 40 and differed only where this copy was BEHIND. The judgement is the same one under the second key the contract requires, since a receipt explains exactly one (artifact, target) pair. The store-only residue of this artifact was measured line by line against the repository and against 814cc61a, the single commit ever promoted. Everything the repository genuinely lacked was harvested into it first (b9866f4, 72809e8 and fa59749). What remains store-only is one of two things, neither worth keeping: a line the repository deliberately changed after 814cc61a -- including five winding doctrines this repo refuted with measurement on 2026-08-23/24 -- or a machine path the privacy gate rejects and promotion regenerates from placeholders. That regeneration was verified by EXECUTING apply against a sandbox target on 2026-08-24, not by reading the code: of 27 such lines, 25 came back as real machine paths, one is a .md that keeps its placeholder by design, and one kept its path two lines lower because the repository grew. The drift has a known and now-fixed cause: a Stop hook written 2026-06-28 told every qualifying session to edit the promotion target directly, and was never updated when the pack took governance on 2026-07-24. The repository is the source of record; the transaction backs this copy up before replacing it.
